hook.line: This has to be the scariest ChatGPT prompt on the internet.
hook.visual: Creator cut out at the bottom right over a black page of prompt text, under a white title box: 'You'll never use ChatGPT the same after this'.

beats.what: Bold claim with the full prompt text already on screen behind him.
He reads the prompt's role line, pointing up at the bolded phrases.
Cut to the next page: 'Your Capabilities' list; 'and that's not all'.
Next page: psycho-spiritual integration and behavioural repatterning.
Instructions page: Phase 1 root cause extraction and later phases.
Tone guidelines and the 'End Result' block.
Cut to his real room with a white title box: comment 'Exposed' and he'll DM it.

why_it_works: Extreme claim ('scariest prompt') plus the uneasy emoji title creates a curiosity gap that the on-screen prompt seems to prove.
The whole prompt is visible but too dense to read, so the comment-keyword CTA ('Exposed') becomes the way to get it, which drives comments (10.8k).
Pointing at bold phrases in the screenshot while reading them keeps one long shot (30 s) alive without edits.
Final cut out of the green screen into a real room signals 'this is the ask' and sets the CTA apart.
weaknesses: First cut only at 30 s; the visual is unchanged for half the video.
No spoken-word captions; a muted viewer only gets the title and a wall of small text.
Most of the length is a list of jargon read aloud with no demo of the result.
for_robert: Steal the comment-keyword CTA with a scene change: cut Fred and Robert out of the content background for the last beat so the 'comment X' ask looks different from the lesson.
